dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Bengals (7-3) Week 12 Briefing: Wednesday Injury Report Ahead of Saints
bullets: Commanders Offensive Surge: Fresh off moving to 7-3 (1st in AFC North) with a 20–22 result against Washington, Cincinnati piled up 312 total yards [Mike Petraglia](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/3125082/dalton-risner#:~:text=Risner%20%28knee%29%20is%20considered%20day-to-day%2C%20Mike%20Petraglia) [Dale Altman](https://www.cincyjungle.com/cincinnati-bengals-analysis/206527/bengals-film-room-joe-burrow-has-an-uneven-performance-on-mnf). Samaje Perine totaled 97 scrimmage yards and 0 touchdowns while Joe Burrow threw for 300 yards and 2 TDs in Zac Taylor's attack [bengals.com Official](https://www.bengals.com/news/quick-hits-joe-burrow-keeps-throwing-d-j-turner-ii-s-short-memory).

Injury & Practice Status: Cincinnati opened WR Andrei Iosivas's 21-day IR practice window. G Dalton Risner (knees) did not practice Wednesday, while CB Jalen Davis (hamstring) and WR Andrei Iosivas (thumb (surgery)) practiced in full [bengals.com Official](https://www.bengals.com/news/week-12-2026-injury-report-saints-bengals).

Week 12 Saints Outlook: Zac Taylor and DC Al Golden open installation for the New Orleans Saints (3-7, CIN -10, HC Kellen Moore, OC Doug Nussmeier & DC Brandon Staley (Paycor Stadium)) as Cincinnati prepares for a pivotal AFC matchup [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/preview?gameId=401873087) [bengals.com Official](https://www.bengals.com/news/week-12-2026-new-orleans-saints-opponent-preview-scouting-report).

AFC Playoff Trajectory: Entering Week 12 at 7-3 (1st in AFC North • #4 Seed in AFC), Cincinnati carries a 96.1% postseason projection, 73% AFC North division title mark, and 5.7% #1 Seed Bye equity into the conference stretch [John Acree](https://www.cincyjungle.com/cincinnati-bengals-analysis/206583/afc-north-standings-week-12-steelers-browns-ravens).
